body:
The maintainer asked for this in chat on 2026-11-22, in his own words:

> issue; enhancement; support for tapered tooling like ball mills, roundover bits and similar, router style tooling.

Part of #3351. Refs #3351. Sub-issue 5 of the plan in #3351.

Depends on #3367
Depends on #3368
Depends on #3369

## What to do

This is slice 2 of the research in #895, made general for any meridian, and the column part of #896 Q5.

1. Column engine (`crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` `plan_ops`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/dexel.rs`, `dexel_arc.rs`): one revolved atom set from the meridian, beside `dexel_bull.rs`. Each convex atom cuts with the existing convex search along straight and arc moves.
2. Field engine (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/field_solid.rs`, `field_cut.rs`, `field_sweep.rs`, `field_arc.rs`, `field_ray.rs`): one `SdfTool` / `RevKind` for the meridian, as the union of the convex atoms. The convex sweep of `field_sweep.rs` stays valid for each atom.
3. Bounds: the cut uses the OUTER bound of a concave arc for the gouge verdict (`deviate`). The rest material that a later operation reads (`crates/app/src/rest/ahead.rs`) uses the INNER bound, so no later operation assumes that material is gone when it is not.
4. `rest::ahead` and `stamp_tool` (`crates/app/src/operation/stamp_tool.rs`) hash the tip form, the tip diameter and the `FormMill` outline.
5. The display reads the same solid.
6. The existing variants for the old kinds stay. A test proves each one equal to its meridian solid before any later issue replaces it.

## Rules

- `effort:max`: the stock simulation (safety floor).
- The old kinds keep identical stock results and digests (pinned).

## Done means

- Column and field engines agree within `DEV_TOL` on straight and arc cuts with a flat-tip taper, a tapered ball nose, a roundover bit and a cove bit (pinned).
- The inner and outer bounds differ by no more than the sag limit (pinned).
- A change of tip form or outline changes the stamp and the rest digest (pinned).
